== Biography ==
Margaret was born about 1780. This remains an estimate; the civil records cited below do not establish her birth date.

She was the wife of [[Glasgow-1538|Robert Glasgow]] and mother of [[Glasgow-2822|Alexander Glasgow]]. An inspected FamilySearch marriage index records Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash at Barony, Lanarkshire, on 6 November 1803. The exact couple and the later parental family evidence support identifying the bride with this existing Margaret.<ref name="Marriage1803">"Scotland, Marriages, 1561-1910", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTTP-F82 : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow, marriage to Margaret Brash, 6 November 1803, Barony, Lanark, Scotland; inspected derivative index, Image Unavailable.</ref> FamilySearch's civil-index displays for Alexander's marriages on 30 April 1861 and 23 April 1867, and his death at Rothesay on 4 October 1875, identify his parents as Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow.<ref name="Civil1861">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLR-J1JQ : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexr Glasgow, 30 April 1861; displayed derivative marriage index, Alexr aged 48, widowed, flesher; Elizabeth Bicket aged 42; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as parents.</ref><ref name="Civil1867">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TPS-Q18Q : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexr Glasgow, 23 April 1867; displayed derivative marriage index, Alexr aged 54, widowed, master flesher; Janet Smith aged 46; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as parents.</ref><ref name="Civil1875">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XSF1-N2WT : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexander Glasgow, 4 October 1875, Rothesay, Buteshire; Alexander aged 62, married, flesher; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as father and mother; Janet Smith listed under Other People. Original image uninspected; access requires a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Civil family review, 30 October 2026 ===
Margaret's identification as Alexander's already attached mother is assessed at 99% confident. This is her first individual percentage, not a new mother attachment or an increase from a recorded previous percentage. The same parental couple accompanies Alexander's consistent ages and flesher occupation across the three dated events. The sources inspected are derivative index displays; the original certificates have not been read. Person rows belonging to the same event are not independent witnesses, and the distinct events' informants have not been checked.

Alexander was recorded as widowed, aged 48, a flesher, with Elizabeth Bicket aged 42 in the 1861 marriage index; in 1867 he was widowed, aged 54, a master flesher, with Janet Smith aged 46. The latter bride is strongly identified with his existing wife [[Smith-231676|Janet Smith]], whose 1871 census account is retained in her own biography. The 1875 death index records Alexander as married, aged 62, a flesher, and lists Janet Smith under Other People; that display label alone does not state Janet's role.

The 1803 marriage index supplies no age, occupation, previous marital status or parents. Its original details, Margaret's own parents and death, and reconciliation of existing profiles remain to be established. Do not merge this Margaret with [[Brash-295]] from this index alone. The marriage does not independently establish Robert's claimed 1760 birth. No birth or death date for her follows from these events. The 1875 image requires a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library. Check the originals for parental details, residences, informants and signatures before extending this family.
